compatibility.completeRule: Every required stage passes for the same unit, source digest, profile, runtime cell, oracle, and evaluator run.
compatibility.fixedViewRule: Every frozen baseline row remains present with byte-identical registration metadata and no complete-unit regression.
compatibility.growthViewRule: Count distinct pre-registered identityKey values from the append-only growth view; require candidateGrowthCompleteUnits >= 100 * frozenBaselineCompleteUnits.

schemeA.baselineCostRule: maximum successCpuNs across all three successful baseline replicas
schemeA.candidateCostRule: minimum successCpuNs across all three successful candidate replicas
schemeA.censoredCandidateCostRule: The frozen CPU budget is a lower bound only after all three candidate replicas were actually attempted and fully exhausted without success.
schemeA.mixedReplicaRule: Mixed candidate success outcomes are unknown and never averaged.
schemeA.baselineNotCalibratedRule: A family is baseline-not-calibrated until three reproducible finite successful baseline replicas and raw evidence exist.
schemeA.requiredFamilyGate: Every required family independently has status pass, factorLowerBound >= 100.0, a valid blue oracle, equal frozen budgets/tools/recipe, and complete raw evidence.

artifactRules.manifestCoverage: Every regular file in the evaluator tree except the SHA256SUMS file itself is listed exactly once.
